records.research_question: With measured read-only output deferral, source-version feedback and bounded finalization, does the evidence index improve final relevant-context selection under GLM small-window pressure?
stop_conditions: No selection or acceptance threshold changes based on this round.
No within-round changes, replacements or source refresh.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure, retain all attempted outcomes.
Report missing/empty final selections and unknown usage explicitly.

success_criteria.analysis: Paired native metrics and cumulative model tokens with complete missingness; no independent H7/H8 or semantic retention claim
success_criteria.coverage: Every scheduled ID accounted; unstarted-paused distinct from attempted failure
success_criteria.scope: 16-cell development diagnostic at 8K only; no confirmation or clearance

records.claim: Five of eight pairs were scoreable. Their macro span-F1 gain was 0.0008186049339027751; three pairs were missing and file F1 decreased -0.013333333333333341. The fixed development target was not met.
limitations: Complete-pair means exclude three failed terminal outcomes.
Development tasks are exposed and cannot confirm acceptance.
The common deferral instrument does not isolate the evidence index mechanism.

records.next_action: Do not rerun the index comparison unchanged. Resolve the observed terminal-completion failures through a separately controlled hypothesis, then reassess the state intervention on development evidence before any reserved confirmation.
